working_definition: Crystal cells (melanizing hemocytes) in adult flies (FCA heart); authors cite the embryonic/larval crystal cell term.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Crystal cell of the adult. Originating from the embryo and the larva, these cells persist in small numbers in the adult (Honti et al., 2014; Gold and Bruckner, 2015).

justification: Data are adult; the adult-specific variant replaces the authors' embryonic/larval crystal cell term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Hemocyte of the embryo and larva.
